verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is PRELOAD_MODELS / --preload-models, which accepts a JSON list of models and applies them together through /models/apply parameters. That is a narrow, startup-time bulk model install, not general bulk operations across items. missing for 10: a batch inference API or batch job endpoint, bulk operations on agents, users or other resources, runtime bulk management via API or UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
